sources.name: Concept2 Logbook, 2025 2000m RowErg Rankings (men, all ages, all weights)
sources.measures: Each man's best 2000m RowErg time logged during the 2025 Concept2 season. Filters: all ages, all weights, all countries, all results (verified and unverified), adaptive excluded. Percentiles are read from rank position: p99 = position 96 of 9,561, p90 = position 956, p50 = position 4,781.
sources.notes: Times as published: position 95 (ties) 6:15.6, position 97 6:15.7, so p1 = 6:15.6. Position 956 = 6:48.4. Position 4,781 sits in a tie at 7:46.8 (positions 4,777 to 4,781). Values are converted to seconds only for the key format. The 2025 season is assumed to run 1 May 2024 to 30 April 2025, which is Concept2's usual season convention; the page itself shows no dates.

sources.name: Concept2 Logbook, 2024 2000m RowErg Rankings (men, all ages, all weights)
sources.measures: Same definition as the 2025 row, for the 2024 season: each man's best 2000m RowErg time, all ages and weights, all results, adaptive excluded. p99 = position 97 of 9,688, p90 = position 969, p50 = position 4,844.
sources.notes: Position 97 = 6:16.5. Position 969 falls in the tie at position 967, 6:49.6. Position 4,844 falls in the tie at position 4,842, 7:46.5. This is a different season of the same database, so it is a separate yearly sample from the same publisher, not an independent organisation. Many rowers likely appear in both seasons.

definition: Each man's best 2000m RowErg time logged during the 2025 Concept2 season. Filters: all ages, all weights, all countries, all results (verified and unverified), adaptive excluded. Percentiles are read from rank position: p99 = position 96 of 9,561, p90 = position 956, p50 = position 4,781.
caveat: The population is self-selected: men who row on a Concept2 RowErg and choose to log a 2000m piece online. Many are club, masters or former competitive rowers, so these times are much faster than the general male population would manage. 'Top 1%' here means the top 1% of ranked men, not of all men. Unverified results are included. Percentiles come from rank positions, not from a distribution Concept2 publishes itself. For comparison only, on a different sample: Silva Alonso, Iglesias Pérez and García Soidán (2018), J. Hum. Sport Exerc. 13(4):731-742, doi:10.14198/JHSE.2018.134.02, fitted age-specific GAMLSS percentile curves to 15,420 online-ranking 2000m results from 2010 to 2014. Its abstract gives no numeric men's values, so it is not listed as a source.

new_metric.label: 2000m indoor rowing time
new_metric.definition: Best time to row 2000 metres on a Concept2 RowErg indoor rowing machine within one season, as logged in the Concept2 online rankings.
phrasings: how fast is a good 2k erg
